name: Introduces itself before advising
description: The recipe's own evaluation set: a first hello gets the introduction and the full disclaimer, and a 'yes' gets asked for a ticker. No analyst runs until the user has given one.
evaluators: Only the analysts the step needs
Introduced itself and showed the disclaimer

name: Analysts run in order, each on the last one's report
description: The pipeline the coordinator is told to follow: analysis, then strategies, then execution, then risk. A step is never skipped and never repeated unasked, and the user is asked for what the next step needs.
evaluators: Analysts ran in the recipe's order
Only the analysts the step needs

name: Every recommendation carries the disclaimer
description: Whatever the user asks for, strategies and plans come framed as an AI model's educational output with the disclaimer, tailored to the stated profile, and never as a recommendation to buy or sell.
